dedupe_keys.name: ised broadcasting database canadian radio and television stations technical data

description: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada publishes its broadcasting database, the technical record of certified radio and television broadcasting stations and allotments in Canada used for broadcast spectrum planning. The downloadable extract gives, for AM, FM, digital radio, analogue and digital television stations and allotments, the call sign, licensee, city and province, frequency or channel, class, coordinates, antenna height above average terrain (HAAT and effective HAAT), power, directional antenna patterns and status, with a user manual explaining the files; ISED notes that HAAT values for DTV allotments were calculated with the Canadian Digital Elevation Data and are for information only. Coverage: all of Canada, current stations and allotments, refreshed with the other spectrum extracts (the database file was dated 23 September 2026). Format and access: a ZIP archive of about 15 MB of database tables with a PDF manual, free under the Open Government Licence - Canada; the TAFL broadcast extract is an alternative. Caveats: technical parameters describe authorizations and plans, not measured coverage; table formats are legacy. Simulation uses: transmitter locations and parameters for broadcast coverage, emergency alerting reach and hazard exposure of broadcast infrastructure. Related records: the ISED spectrum extracts cover other services, and the FCC TV coverage baseline and ANFR installations are counterparts.
